stop_rule_fired: S1 (cumulative result-bearing CPU reached the frozen 0.20 CPU-hour cap)
cap_enforced_by: external watchdog polling the worker's CPU time every 5 s, killing it the first time CPU >= 720 s
phase_reached: m=2 certification (certify_F1); the resolvent and the m=1 baseline repeats had completed

inferred_lower_bound_on_ratio_incrementa.basis: phase ordering plus Gate-1's measured 30.85 CPU-s for exactly this m=1 call: resolvent ~0.4 s + 2 x m=1 ~62 s leaves >= 660 s consumed by at most 2 m=2 repeats without completing. This is an INFERENCE from ordering, not a measurement; no timing was recorded before the kill.

cause.classification: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT (in this pilot, not in the architecture)
cause.mechanism: the m=2 source chain applied _kernel_polynomials six times to h_1 and to d_e h_1 = -S_0^raw, whose EXACT series representations are bidegree (121,121) and (120,120), against the bidegree (12,12) candidate the m=1 path feeds in. _kernel_polynomials substitutes, multiplies by the degree-120 phi series and integrates symbolically in z, so a 10x higher degree per variable inflates every intermediate TriPoly and roughly doubles the z-degree.
cause.note: h_1 IS closed form; being closed form does not make its polynomial representation small. This is the same lesson class as Gate-2A's exponential-Gaussian closed form needing 400+ bits: mathematically exact is not computationally cheap in the chosen representation.

identified_repair_NOT_APPLIED.design: treat h_1 as Gate-1's MSHARE accounting already does -- as its own CERTIFIED FUNCTION with a degree-12 exact-dyadic candidate hhat_1 plus a certified residual -- and apply the kernel to hhat_1, never to the exact degree-121 series. Every kernel application in the m=2 chain then acts on a degree-12 object, exactly as m=1 does.
identified_repair_NOT_APPLIED.why_not_applied: the frozen rules forbid adaptive repair after T2 and forbid extending the cap after results. The repair must be re-preregistered and run as its own gate.
identified_repair_NOT_APPLIED.expected_effect: UNMEASURED. It is NOT claimed that the corrected ratio is acceptable; that is precisely what the successor gate must test.

what_this_gate_did_NOT_establish: correspondence of R_{CUSUM,2}(1/4) against Monte Carlo (never reached)
any updated P5Y CPU band (the Gate-2B bands stand unchanged)
what_survives: the exact raw-variable m=2 assembly R_2 = (1/2)[F_0(x0) + F_1(x0) + S_0^raw(x0)], derived from P5X-T1(c) and verified against the probabilistic decomposition
the m-sharing structure: m=2 adds ONE resolvent solve (F_1) and its derivative, and no new solve architecture
d_e h_1 = -S_0^raw, an exact identity used by the derivative source
